Subject: Panoptic Health — Pre-implementation handoff & kickoff asks

Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for signing. Quick handoff note from the deal team so CS can pick up planning. This thread captures the minimum required info for a smooth kickoff and the mutual action plan (MAP) we attached. Please see the short summary below and the two attachments: Panoptic_SOW_v1.pdf and PH-Kickoff-MAP.xlsx.

High-level context
- Scope: Real-time clinical summarization + embeddings for chart search across 2 clinics (approx 120k monthly requests during pilot).
- Target go-live (pilot): Aug 15, 2028 — pilot will be in two waves (clinic A then clinic B).
- Contract: 12-month pilot, PH-4521, committed reserved capacity with Redwood Dedicated (baseline vCPU/GPU pool 2x A10).

Key customer constraints / asks (from sales)
- Data residency: all PH patient data must remain in their US VPC region and KMS-backed keys (no external backups).
- SOC2 evidence required before staging access (customer security team will run questionnaire).
- Procurement needs a single POC for invoicing (Priya Singh).

Open technical risks
- Model latency at 1024 tokens under our default batching — anticipate needing to tweak KV cache and batching window for clinic EHR traffic pattern.
- PH uses a lightly-customized HL7->FHIR transform that may insert long prefixes; we should plan a prompt preprocessor guardrail.

Immediate asks for CS (action items)
1) Confirm primary CS owner and shadow (named below)
2) Schedule initial kickoff with PH security & infra (request window: Thu 6/8 or Fri 6/9, US morning)
3) Validate required SOC2 artifacts list (Karthik will share current pack)
4) Draft staging access timeline and acceptance criteria (we aim for staging by 7/10)

Marcus will remain on thread for the next two weeks for clarifications.

Attachments: Panoptic_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW, PDF), PH-Kickoff-MAP.xlsx (MAP, XLSX)

--
